snippet.name: spawn_blocking
snippet.label: Method
snippet.source:
pub fn spawn_blocking<F, R>(&self, func: F) -> JoinHandle<R>
    where
        F: FnOnce() -> R + Send + 'static,
        R: Send + 'static,
    {
        self.inner.blocking_spawner().spawn_blocking(self, func)
    }
